title: OpenTimestamps
description: Timestamp the completed archive manifest, including any saved TLS certificates and TLSNotary proofs, using OpenTimestamps and Bitcoin.

OPENTIMESTAMPS_ENABLED.description: Submit a blinded commitment of hashes.json to calendar servers. No API key is required.

OPENTIMESTAMPS_BINARY.description: Path to the OpenTimestamps Python client CLI.

OPENTIMESTAMPS_TIMEOUT.description: Total hook budget in seconds; submission reserves two seconds for publishing outputs.

OPENTIMESTAMPS_CALENDARS.description: Calendar URLs to submit to. Use HTTPS for public services or HTTP for a local calendar.

OPENTIMESTAMPS_REQUIRED_CALENDARS.description: Minimum successful calendar replies required to save a proof. Must not exceed the number of distinct configured calendars.
